description: PRIMARY 投研观点与卖方研报（优先于 `news`）。按 `code`/`concept_id`/`analyst`/`institution`/日期浏览；按主题关键词检索请用 `search(type='views')` 再 `views_get`。约 10% 带研报全文，读研报传 `report_only=true` 后调 `report`。默认 `fields=compact`，大批量初筛用 `fields=index`。A+H 传 A 股代码。

_fields.description: 逗号分隔的直接字段；有 items 时投影每行，否则投影 data；外层字段或嵌套结构用 _jq

_intent.description: 用户原问题一句话，仅分析用，可留空

_jq.description: JMESPath，对 data 求值（写 items[*].id）

_max_bytes.description: 响应字节上限，默认约 50 KB

_max_bytes_mode.description: 正文超限处理，默认 truncate 保留前缀

_spill.description: true=全量落盘，只回摘要与取数地址

code.description: Filter by security canonical_code (e.g. SSE:600519, HK:00700, US:AAPL)

concept_id.description: 按概念 ID 查关联券商观点（与 code/analyst/institution/report_only/from/to/cursor/offset/fields 互斥）

cursor.description: Opaque snapshot pagination cursor from the previous response's `next_cursor` (freezes time window & sort anchor; preferred over `offset`).

fields.description: Response shape: `index` (thinnest, ~150 B/row: id, published_at, source_label, primary security canonical_code/security_name/recommend_action, one-line headline, full_text_available, doc_kind — no body; 60 rows ≈ 9 KB, list-then-pick), `compact` (default — ai_summary + first ~300 chars; `securities` lists only non-primary names, `attachment` only kind/name) or `full` (complete content).

from.description: History range start (China date YYYY-MM-DD). Range mode: needs a filter; Pro-only up to 365 days back.

offset.description: Legacy pagination offset (prefer `cursor` from `next_cursor` to avoid duplicates/skips on a live stream).

report_only.description: true = only formal research reports, i.e. views whose full text is archived and readable via `report` (full_text_available). Omit for the mixed feed (~10% reports). Use true whenever the task is to actually read sell-side research.

since_days.description: Lookback in days. ≤30 = rolling feed; >30 switches to range history (needs code / analyst / institution; Pro up to 365). `limit` applies newest-first within the window — read `actual_window` and page with `cursor` (from `next_cursor`) if it falls short.

to.description: History range end (inclusive, China date; defaults to today). Use with from.

name: views
